full_prompt_en: A square color photograph places the rear quarter of a red vintage car close to the left foreground of a quiet suburban street. Its rounded trunk, chrome bumper, and circular taillights are sharply visible, while the road recedes toward modest houses, utility poles, and a distant pale building. Long dark shadows stretch across the asphalt under a clear turquoise-blue sky with small white clouds. Telephone wires cut diagonally through the upper frame, adding a casual graphic structure to the otherwise ordinary scene. The red paint is rich but not perfectly glossy, and warm sunlight turns the pavement and house walls dusty orange. Trees at the upper left create a deep shaded canopy that frames the car. The low camera angle makes the vehicle feel close and substantial, while the empty street opens to the right. Colors have the slightly faded, warm-cool tension of an older color print: saturated red, cyan sky, brownish shadow, and sun-bleached cream. Fine film grain and natural imperfections keep the scene documentary rather than commercial. The whole frame treats a banal roadside moment as visually compelling through color, off-center framing, and unforced afternoon light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色照片把红色老车的后侧近距离放在宁静郊区街道的左前景。圆润后备厢、镀铬保险杠和圆形尾灯清楚可见，道路则向普通民居、电线杆和远处浅色建筑退去。清澈青蓝天空中浮着小白云，长长深影横过柏油路。电话线斜切上方画框，为日常场景添上一点随意的图形结构。红漆丰厚却并非完美油亮，暖日光把路面和屋墙照成带灰的橙色。左上树冠形成深暗阴影，围住车身。低机位使车辆贴近而有分量，空街道向右侧打开。颜色具有旧彩色印刷照片略褪色的冷暖张力：饱和红、青蓝天空、偏棕阴影和被太阳晒白的乳色。细微胶片颗粒与自然瑕疵让场景偏纪实而非商业广告。整幅画通过色彩、偏心构图和不刻意的午后光，把平凡路边瞬间变得引人注目。
style_prompt_en: An everyday color-photography style finds visual force in off-center framing, strong ordinary sunlight, and slightly faded print color. One saturated warm object sits close to the lens against a broad cyan or blue sky and warm dusty street. Utility lines, tree canopies, and simple buildings provide casual geometry without polished arrangement. Deep side shadows and sun-bleached surfaces create distinct color areas. Chrome or other small reflective details catch light, while grain and minor imperfections preserve documentary immediacy. The scene stays mundane and unforced; its character comes from low viewpoint, warm-cool contrast, and a generous stretch of open road or space.
style_prompt_zh: 日常彩色摄影风格从偏心取景、强烈却寻常的日光和略微褪色的印刷色彩中获得视觉力量。一处饱和暖色物体靠近镜头，背后是宽阔青蓝天空和暖而带灰的街面。电线、树冠和简单建筑提供随意几何，没有抛光式摆布。深侧影和被太阳晒白的表面形成清楚色区。镀铬或其他小反光细节接住光，颗粒与轻微瑕疵保留纪实现时性。场景依旧平凡而自然；气质来自低机位、冷暖对照和宽阔的开放道路或空间。
theme_en: A red vintage car parked on a sunlit suburban street
theme_zh: 一辆红色老车停在阳光下的郊区街道
name: William Eggleston
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
